t: You're looking at Encompass, a sculpture by Michael Speller, set in Greenwich Market. Speller, born in 1958, made the piece, and it stands among the stalls and the crowds of the market. The title suggests something that surrounds or holds, so see whether the shape of the work seems to wrap around a space. I don't have any more detail about its materials or history, so take a moment to walk around it, and see how it feels amid the bustle.
